Theo, please make sure the compliance note gets filed against this service as you mentioned. Once the revised draft is ready, circulate it for another round of review before I sign off. And I agree with Marta's recommendation — we should hold off on next Wednesday's deployment target until the draft is updated and re-reviewed. Rushing a first production deployment with known compliance and ordering issues isn't worth the risk.
